reviews.comment: The material is difficult, but Dr. Abido is one of those professors who cares so much about his students that you'll actually want to put in the work for him. His feedback is thoughtful, and in turn he listens to thoughtful feedback from his students and meaningfully changed the structure of his class for our success. 1000% worth the 8 AM class.

Dr. Abido is, without a doubt, the best professor I have taken. He is so kind, understanding, and his lectures are amazing. He finds ways to teach you difficult concepts in a more digestible manner. He puts in a lot of effort and time to ensure class success. Best professor, please take him!

He cares a lot about the students in his classes. I had an F after missing the first month of lectures and managed to pull it back to an A with his feedback. He also changed a lot of the future assignments in the middle of the semester according to the results of a class survey. If you commit yourself to the bare minimum rigor, then you'll be good.

Dr. Abdio is one of the best profs I have had; he is caring, considerate, and has a genuine passion for teaching and seeing his students succeed. 315 is a difficult course, but he teaches the topics in a way that is understandable, and he provides exam reviews to help prepare. He is helpful during office hours and is quick to answer emails!
One of the best professors I've had so far at Texas A&M. Very caring for each student and has a passion for teaching.

He's the GOAT. I was blessed enough to get him for two of my classes (315 and 305) this semester. If every professor at this school cared half as much about their students as Dr. Abido, we'd be pretty alright.

Dr. Abido is awesome! In-class discussions count as attendance, so take the practice. Weekly quizzes are examples of HW questions. Exams are hard but graded nicely. Abido really wants to see his students succeed and is very passionate about the class. If you get a 100 on an exam or A in the class, he laser cuts you a plaque of the class logo!

Dr. Abido cares a ton about his students. He always has a great attitude and goes above and beyond to make sure you have enough practice. He grades very generously with partial credit on exams and they are exactly like the homework. He also takes mid-year feedback very seriously and will actually reads all of them and make the changes you request.

Abido is genuinely one of the most caring and attentive professors I've had so far. He is extremely kind and helpful during office hours and very encouraging. Despite how hard thermo is I've found myself to be enjoying the material purely because of him. He even gives you a prize if you score full points on a test.

Genuinely one of the best professors you can take during college. He actually cares about his students, cares that they understand the course, and cares that they not only succeed in his course but also in life. I would not be surprised if he had the charity to keep me fed and clothed while I was his student. If you value education take his course.

He made Fluid Mechanics an incredibly easy topic and provided many example problems and held amazing review sessions a week before the exam. He did quizzes every Thursday so that expectation was made clear on our attendance. They were very easy if you did the homework's and went to lecture. Very awesome professor who cares for his students.

Abido cares so much about his students. He was always giving motivational speeches. He also takes student feedback into account when making changes in the class. He is a very good lecturer and works through a lot of examples. He is very helpful during office hours as well.

You can tell he genuinely cares. He would give motivational speeches before every exam, and would generally give advices about life. Midterms were relatively easy and common. Final was a bit tough due to time crunch.
Absolute best professor. Take him if you can!

Dr.Abido makes a very scary seeming class (fluid mechanics) extremely approachable. The home works and quizzes are difficult, but they, along with Dr.Abido's review sessions prepare you extremely well for the Exams which are most of your grade. I do not think there is a better prof for MEEN 344. He is genuinely one of the best teachers I've had.

He said a few slightly pretentious things throughout the semester, but he does clearly care about student outcomes. He always takes time to adequately explain concepts, reinforce them with in-class practice, hold good reviews for all exams, and has candy and other small prizes for students as rewards for various things. He's nice, go for him.

Dr. Abido cares A LOT about his students' success in both class and in life. He works very hard to ensure that all of his students have an opportunity to excel in his class and is very accessible outside of class. He is one of the best profs I've had, and I would love to take him again. He makes Fluid Mechanics much more doable than I thought.

Dr Abido is fantastic, I created an account on here after years of lurking simply to sing his praises, if you have the option to, TAKE THIS CLASS, you will not regret it, this has been one of the most fun engineering classes I have ever gotten to take. This went from being a class I dreaded to one I looked forward to. Save your sanity, take Abido.

Abido is my favorite prof at TAMU so far. There's a quiz every week, however they are very easy if you pay attention the previous class. Test averages were consistently a 90. Honestly such a fun prof, mind u this was an 8am for me. No reason to fail or even get a C its just not possible because he does test reviews and so many example problems.

Dr. Abido is an amazing prof. It's a difficult subject but he made it seem pretty easy. He does example problems in every class that are similar to the homework problems. The HW can be a bit time consuming but greatly helps to learn the content. The exams are also similar to the homework. Weekly quizzes over HW. Has review sessions before exams.

mahmoud abido more like mahmoud libido, cause this guys a snack. 
there are HELLA quizzes, HELLA discussion assignments, and HELLA homeworks. 
the class is easy, mahmoud is definitely top 3 professor ive had here in my 3 years at a&m.
He was a GOATED Prof.
Awesome, always helpful and kind. Teaches well and makes sure you know what you need to for exams. One of the best professors I've had.

Professor Abido is easily my favorite professor I have ever had in college. He truly cares about his students learning the material and does everything in his power to get you there. He held office hours at 10 PM on a Sunday night before the final. Sitting in MEEN 368 wishing he was still my professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great Guy, willing to work with you on everything. Material is understandable, good exam formats

Easily the best professor I've had, Mahmoud Abido is caring, patient, funny, intelligent among many other things. His amazing lectures make it very easy to learn, and I would take him for every course if possible. Great exam reviews, straightforward hw and quizzes. Everyone I that took his class agrees he is the best professor on campus.

Without a doubt Mahmoud is an incredible professor. These are just a few things that make him the best professor I have had in college.

- Hardworking and thoughtful
- Cares about the students 
- Sacrifices to promote learning
- Gives advice for school and life.

If you have Mahmoud, you are going to enjoy the class because he cares so much.

This is truly the best professor I have ever had. He is an incredible teacher, but more than that an incredible person. He cares for you and it shows. Every day he sacrifices to teach us and do it in a way that is so easy to understand. He takes a hard class, but because of his love, makes it easy. I wish every prof was like Abido!
